name: NYC x DSSG
heroSubtitle: From tech unemployment to career-ready work.
heroDescription: Entry-level tech job postings in NYC have fallen 49% since 2022, putting early-career talent at historic risk of prolonged unemployment. The Data Diplomats Training Program matches job-seeking technologists with qualified social workers, under-resourced nonprofits, and NGOs to gain career-ready experience solving real data challenges in grassroots communities through human-centered AI.
